import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = data.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
product_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color='#8B4513')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by Time of Day
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
time_sales = data.groupby('time')['total'].sum()
ax2.plot(range(len(time_sales)), time_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, color='#D2691E')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Time of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(time_sales)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(time_sales.index, rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sales by Customer Age Group
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_sales = data.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
colors = ['#FFE4B5', '#DEB887', '#CD853F', '#8B4513', '#654321']
age_sales.plot(kind='pie', ax=ax3, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors[:len(age_sales)])
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('')

# 4. Payment Method Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
payment_counts = data['payment_method'].value_counts()
payment_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#A0522D', '#D2B48C'])
ax4.set_title('Transactions by Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
takeaway_sales = data.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['#8B4513', '#CD853F'])
ax5.set_title('Sales: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Order Type')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax5.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=0)

# 6. Size Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
size_counts = data['size'].value_counts()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_counts = size_counts.reindex([s for s in size_order if s in size_counts.index])
size_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color=['#DEB887', '#CD853F', '#8B4513'])
ax6.set_title('Orders by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Size')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Orders')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 7. Average Price by Product
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
avg_price = data.groupby('product')['price'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
avg_price.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax7, color='#A0522D')
ax7.set_title('Average Price by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Average Price ($)')
ax7.set_ylabel('Product')

# 8. Quantity Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
data['quantity'].hist(ax=ax8, bins=range(1, data['quantity'].max()+2), 
                      color='#D2691E', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_title('Quantity Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Quantity per Order')
ax8.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 9. Summary Statistics Table
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_stats = [
    ['Total Revenue', f"${data['total'].sum():.2f}"],
    ['Avg Order Value', f"${data['total'].mean():.2f}"],
    ['Total Orders', f"{len(data)}"],
    ['Avg Quantity', f"{data['quantity'].mean():.1f}"],
    ['Most Popular', f"{data['product'].mode()[0]}"]
]
table = ax9.table(cellText=summary_stats, cellLoc='left',
                  colWidths=[0.5, 0.5], loc='center',
                  bbox=[0, 0.2, 1, 0.6])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(10)
table.scale(1, 2)
for i in range(len(summary_stats)):
    table[(i, 0)].set_facecolor('#DEB887')
    table[(i, 1)].set_facecolor('#F5DEB3')
ax9.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
